criteria.criterion: Access Microsoft Careers and attempt search for an Applied Scientist role in Redmond, WA
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent successfully attempted the correct search on Microsoft Careers with the requested keyword and location and reached results. Baseline already full; no change.

criteria.criterion: Open one relevant listing (Applied Scientist; Redmond, WA if available) and use it as the extraction source
criteria.final_justification: Despite action-history not showing a click, screenshots clearly demonstrate one relevant listing is opened/selected and includes Redmond in its location. This satisfies the criterion; increase from baseline 0 to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the job number from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent reported a specific job number that is not supported anywhere in the visual evidence; this is best scored as fabrication rather than 'not visible'. Keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Work-site arrangement is not evidenced in screenshots; agent asserted a specific arrangement anyway. This is unsupported, so no credit.

criteria.criterion: Extract two key responsibilities from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Agent did not provide two responsibilities. While some bullets are visible, they are not clearly responsibilities, and none were extracted in the final answer. No credit.

criteria.criterion: Extract two preferred qualifications from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Even though the page shows at least one clearly 'preferred'-style bullet, the agent did not extract/provide two preferred qualifications in its final output. No credit.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission; stop after one listing)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints (no sign-in, no apply, no form submission) appear respected. While the agent failed to complete the stopping condition’s info capture, this criterion is specifically about respecting constraints and stopping behavior; evidence supports no prohibited actions. Keep full credit.
